description: Pump-only clear north wallpaper wall irradiance. A closed diffuse room proxy retains the original study sconce and desk-candle lights but excludes the study sun, window sky and furniture shadows. Cycles Metal, 256 samples, denoised and encoded with the original study scale. UV0 wallpaper repeat is unchanged.
note: Cycles GPU and denoising can vary across Blender versions and hardware; update the texture hash after regeneration.
